trial_court: First Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Durg (Case No. not mentioned)
case_name: Akshay Choudhary vs Smt. Pratibha Choudhary
facts_of_case: The parties were married under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The petitioner sought divorce under Section 13 of the Act, 1955. The trial court dismissed the petition. The parties settled their dispute outside the court and filed an application for dissolution of marriage by mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: Parties seeking divorce by mutual consent must file a duly constituted application under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: However, in absence of duly constituted application under Section 13-B of the Act, 1955, parties were allowed time to do the needful.

legal_principles.principle: Parties must comply with the terms and conditions agreed upon for dissolution of marriage by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: They have filed an application under Section 13-B of the Act, 1955 for dissolution of marriage by decree of divorce by mutual consent as per terms and conditions, which are reproduced herein :-

outcome.final_order: The parties' application for dissolution of marriage by mutual consent was accepted.
